tools.name: get_guidance
tools.description: Read one engineering guidance topic whole: facts and verification procedures for integration, build and release work. Topics under this host’s policy: android-release-verification (Verify the Android shipping variant before landing); ci-failures (Diagnose CI from the failed operation); container-preflight (Verify the production container before landing); entitlement-cache (Paid backend access and cached store verdicts); gradle-distributions (Verify and recover the Android Gradle distribution); install-identity (Durable install identity); local-discovery (Local-device discovery); native-callback-lifetime (Native callback ownership and teardown); native-dependencies (Native dependency locks and runtime parity); native-outcomes (Native outcome checks); product-behavior (Verify the product's data, upgrades and scheduling behavior); workflow-validation (Validate GitHub Actions workflows and build inputs).

instructions: Engineering facts and verification procedures for integration, build and release work. get_guidance names every topic this host’s launch policy serves; read a topic when the work reaches it and apply the whole answer. Use the host’s existing delivery and credential tooling for execution.
